access_evidence: probe nih_reporter_get_405: GET returns HTTP 405 with a zero-byte body (POST is mandatory). POST probe nih_reporter_search_post in POST_CALLS.json: HTTP 200 with a meta block. 6 POSTs total: 1 discovery + 4 bounded pages + 1 probe.
blockers: GET is not supported (HTTP 405, empty body). Any connector that only does GET will report this source as broken.
historical_depth: Award notice date and project start/end dates are separate fields, so the award's own event date and its public-visible date are distinguishable.
licence_note: RePORTER's FAQ answers 'Is the data copyrighted?' with no: it is US federal government data, public domain in the United States (https://reporter.nih.gov/faq). Recorded as public_domain.
name: NIH RePORTER v2
notes: criteria.project_nums accepts BARE core numbers such as R01EB026995 and returns core_project_num in every row, which is what makes the grant<->work link machine-verified. A looser core-number regex also accepted the Japan AMED id 'JP22fk0210090'; the tightened six-digit serial rule rejects it and the rejected candidate is logged in REPORTER_INDEX.json.
rate_policy: No key documented; used sequentially with small limits (<=50/page, <=6 pages).
what_is_new: The only open grant registry in the source set that resolves a declared grant number to a specific project and echoes core_project_num back. Nine declared NIH cores all resolved; 64 project records captured with full paging (170/170 rows for the queried cores).
